name: DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections (Historical)
description:
This dataset contains historical inspection records for New York City childcare centers regulated by the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Each row represents a single inspection and combines facility information—center and legal name, address, borough, ZIP code, phone, permit number and status, age range served, maximum capacity, program type, facility type, and childcare type—with inspection outcomes. These outcomes include inspection date, summary result, violation rates overall and for public health hazards and critical violations, average rates for comparison, educational staffing counts, regulation summaries, violation categories and health code subsections, and whether each violation was corrected or remains open.

The data covers roughly 5,000 sampled records across all five boroughs, with Brooklyn and Queens most represented. It can be used to track inspection outcomes and violation patterns across centers, boroughs, and facility types; compare compliance by capacity, program type, or staffing levels; examine trends over time; and support research or policy analysis on childcare health and safety oversight.
